plainTranslation: Someone's planet on your North Node - your growth direction - feels like they pull you toward who you're becoming. Stretching, sometimes uncomfortable, often worth it. Growth, not a guarantee. The pull doesn't mean forever.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
